categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Jieqiang Power Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the nuclear, biological, and chemical (NBC) safety equipment sector. Its main business includes the research, development, production, sales, and service of nuclear radiation monitoring equipment, biological detection devices, hydraulic power systems for NBC decontamination equipment, and other NBC safety equipment and technical services. The company also provides integrated NBC safety solutions and professional value-added services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent research and development with proprietary intellectual property rights, focusing on core technologies in nuclear radiation detection, biological safety detection, and decontamination equipment. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including digital equipment processing, standardized production, and quality control systems compliant with GJB9001C-2017 and ISO9000 standards. The R&D approach combines in-house innovation with collaborative projects involving military academies and universities, focusing on modular, integrated, and intelligent NBC safety equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies and institutions in environmental protection, health commissions, medical sectors, safety supervision, customs, firefighting, nuclear industry upstream and downstream systems, military logistics, and scientific research institutes. The company serves both military and civilian markets, with applications in nuclear emergency rescue, law enforcement monitoring, public health measurement, and nuclear radiation technology utilization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and production facilities in Tianjin, Shanghai, Chengdu, and other locations. Its market coverage is domestic, serving various regional government and military clients across China. There is no significant mention of international operations or overseas markets in the report.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianjin Jieqiang operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the NBC safety equipment supply chain. It undertakes the full lifecycle of product development from R&D, manufacturing, to sales and after-sales service. The company also integrates system solutions by combining its own products with external brands to meet complex customer demands.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on building an integrated NBC safety equipment and service system, emphasizing continuous technological innovation and product iteration. R&D priorities include nuclear radiation monitoring, biological detection, and decontamination technologies, with projects targeting modular mobile units, ozone catalytic oxidation disinfection robots, and advanced detection instruments. It pursues high-value patents, collaborates with top research institutions, and aims to enhance product intelligence, standardization, and platform capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of NBC safety equipment and related technical services. The company operates on an order-based and customized sales model, including direct sales to government and military clients. It also earns income from after-sales services and technical support. Non-core revenues include cash management investment income and occasional asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading private enterprise in China’s NBC safety equipment industry, especially in nuclear radiation detection and biological safety detection. It holds a competitive edge through its comprehensive product portfolio, technological innovation, and market access. The industry features intense competition, with domestic firms focusing on mid-to-low-end markets and international giants dominating high-end segments. The company leverages its market entry barriers, professional expertise, and R&D capabilities to maintain its industry standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported a significant decline in financial performance with total assets of approximately RMB 1.31 billion, down 15.66% year-over-year, and net assets attributable to shareholders of RMB 965 million, down 23.76%. Operating revenue dropped 52.81% to RMB 138.38 million, and net loss attributable to shareholders widened to RMB 278.26 million, a 309.78% decrease. The company experienced negative operating cash flow and increased asset impairment losses, reflecting challenges in order fulfillment and pricing adjustments. Despite setbacks, the company continues to invest in R&D and strategic restructuring.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its mission to empower NBC safety, offering integrated equipment systems and comprehensive technical services tailored to public safety, environmental protection, and healthcare sectors. Its products feature advanced detection precision, modular design, and intelligent integration, supported by a strong R&D team with deep domain expertise. The company’s unique value lies in its full lifecycle service capability, domestic core component development, and close collaboration with military and scientific institutions, enabling it to meet complex and evolving NBC safety demands.
